summary: Phase 1 (Component availability + bulk install + dual assignment history + concurrency-safe install) verified. Added new backend suite test_it_components_phase1.py with 10 targeted tests: availability shape+counts, exclude param, none-message, bulk install of 2 RAMs, transaction rollback when one component in batch is pre-installed, concurrency guard on single install (same component can't land in 2 assets), assign->transfer->return with dual asset+component assignment history and physical history containing only Created+Installed (no phantom Remove/Install from reassign), return closes all component periods while components remain installed, physical remove+reinstall records events, and RBAC 403 for employee on availability + install-components. Result: 10/10 PASS. Frontend Add-Asset dialog verified: 'Components (optional)' section renders, avail-type-select works, counts strip shows Total 11 / Used 6 / Available 5, and avail-opt-{id} rows list only currently-free RAM components (RAM-0001..RAM-0005). Existing IT Component regression suite still lives at /app/backend/tests/test_it_components.py.

minor.issue: counts key naming is fine but does not include 'reserved' bucket in the response even though 'Reserved' is a valid C_STATUS; low priority since not requested in spec.

design_issues.screen: Add Asset dialog (Purchase / Warranty / AMC sections)
issues: Uses browser default native date pickers (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar component — inconsistent with rest of the app. Not Phase-1 scope but flagged per design guidelines.

action_items: None blocking for Phase 1. Optional: expose 'reserved' bucket in availability counts. Optional: replace native date pickers in Add Asset with shadcn Calendar (out of Phase-1 scope).
critical_code_review_comments: assignment_history.py sync_components_on_asset_reassign correctly avoids emitting physical Install/Remove events — verified by asserting component.history.action only contains Created+Installed after asset transfer.
components.py _do_install uses find_one_and_update guarded by parent_asset_id null + status not in blocked list — concurrency-safe, verified.
asset_install_components rolls back already-installed components on batch failure — verified: c_free returned to Available with parent_asset_id null.
Route ordering: /it/components/availability is declared before /it/components/{component_id} — correct (literal-before-dynamic), verified 200 responses.

Consider using MongoDB transactions (session start_session) instead of manual rollback loop in asset_install_components; the manual rollback works but is not atomic if the rollback itself partially fails.
components.py is now ~920 LOC — exceeds the 700-line soft cap. Recommend splitting into components_core.py + components_import.py + components_lifecycle.py as suggested in the previous iteration.
return-asset flow correctly calls sync_components_on_asset_reassign(..., None, ...) to close component assignment periods without removing components — verified.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-1 regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_it_components_phase1.py. IMPORTANT: writing to backend/tests/ triggers uvicorn WatchFiles reload (~30-45s downtime); after editing, `sleep 45` before running pytest. Employees endpoint returns dict with key 'employees' (NOT 'items'). Asset assignment uses employee snapshot payload {employee_id, employee_name, emp_code, department, designation}. Return endpoint expects {'return_status': 'Available'} (or similar valid status).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Initial pytest run showed ReadTimeout — cause was pytest editing test file inside backend/tests/ which triggered uvicorn reload mid-request. Fixed by increasing timeout and waiting for reload to complete before re-running.
